withinProcessOrder: Forward for even rounds, reversed for odd rounds
aggregation: Report per-arm median and min/max across 20 samples per workload. Pair adjacent arm processes, comparing each process median, then report all four paired ratios and their median.
scope: Pure shimmer helper and actual wait renderer, not full application frames. Real renderer sanitizes ZWJ to spaces. No throughput or speedup claim inferred from synthetic helper alone.
runtime: Official Bun 1.3.14, npm native 18.8.8 source-equivalent to public release; no local native rebuild
